customManagers.description: Track the digest-only agent sandbox image assembled from an Ansible Jinja expression; the shared Docker manager only parses literal image values.

ARC Helm charts are OCI refs consumed as a plain Ansible variable (kubernetes.core.helm chart_ref/chart_version), not a Chart.yaml/values.yaml Renovate's native Helm managers scan. Tracked against the GitHub release tag both charts share (gha-runner-scale-set-<version>).
Helm CLI static release, installed by github_runner_arc rather than a package manager.
k3s server release installed by github_runner_arc.

Single org-wide node_exporter version, consumed by roles/node_exporter via node_exporter_version rather than a literal pin in the role. Tracked against upstream's GitHub releases; the role re-derives the tarball checksum from the release's own sha256sums.txt on every converge, so a bump here is never inert.

packageRules.description: Keep current SHA pins when the annotated release version is unchanged.
Apply the seven-day release soak to first-party GitHub dependencies.
Object-storage upgrades can rewrite on-disk metadata that an older release cannot read, so they open as pull requests without auto-merge.
OpenProject AIO majors need a deliberate sequential upgrade + bundled Postgres data migration (see #928). Block automatic major bumps; minor/patch still flow.

Technitium is mirror-hosted, so a version bump alone is inert-to-broken: Renovate cannot re-seed the object-storage tarball, re-checksum it, or move the .NET runtime pin when a major changes target framework (15.x is net10.0, 14.x was net9.0). A major landed unattended once and left the pins pointing at a 404. Block major bumps so they stay operator-driven per the re-seed note in roles/technitium_install/defaults/main.yml; minor/patch still flow.

Upstream Homarr's latest release line is 2.x, and the first instance (roles/homarr/defaults/main/00-pin.yml) stays on 1.x. Cap that pin below 2 so Renovate keeps proposing 1.x minors and patches but never a major. A second instance pins its own version in inventory/host_vars and is not capped.
